replacements.old: - [ ] Make null/empty scaffolding disappear. The [payload inspection](../verification/level1-decisions.md#payload-inspection) found: `## General knowledge notepad` renders `{"subjectId":null,...,"text":""}` when empty; `## Me` keeps trailing spaces from empty feelings/kinship values; the combined Jev rating state carries empty values (`commitments: []`, `feelings: ""`, `goal: ""`) where generation says “None supplied.”; every generation context ends with `{"privateInventionResults":[]}` when invention is locked with no results. Not done on `codex/level1-decisions`: the text is built in `decision-context.ts`/`response-context.ts`, assigned to the parallel actions branch, and `actor-invention.ts`, which `codex/integrate-invention` also changes; editing them here would collide with that work. Fix in those branches or after they merge.
replacements.new: - [ ] Remove irrelevant empty prompt scaffolding through the existing shared context owners. The [payload inspection](../verification/level1-decisions.md#payload-inspection) recorded the empty general notepad, trailing feeling/kinship spaces, empty rating-state values and empty private invention history. Current `response-context.ts` still emits the empty notepad and interpolated spaces; `actor-invention.ts` still serializes `privateInventionResults` when empty. Preserve meaningful absence such as no food. The former parallel-branch collision is no longer a prerequisite; fix the integrated owners without another context format or a second prompt builder.

replacements.old: Downtime eligibility requires no immediate survival emergency or responsibility demanding attention. Purposeful native work continues; introspection must not displace it. Meaningful unprocessed experiences, unresolved concerns, a supported periodic review or approaching authored capacity can create a reflection opportunity. Jev can choose reflection alongside continuing ordinary activity.
replacements.new: Current maintenance eligibility uses the body/availability policy and requires idle physical execution before dispatching intentional reflection. Purposeful native work continues; a queued reflection does not displace it. Existing remembered experience may be reconsidered repeatedly; it is not consumed by a processed-memory watermark. Routing can request later reflection while an immediate decision or valid action proceeds independently.

replacements.old: Track the actor's experience boundary, idle/sleep episode and last accepted reflection. Coalesce repeated triggers, stagger actors and use real-time cooldowns and shared caps. Completing a reflection while still idle must not immediately schedule another over unchanged evidence. Mark processing progress only after accepted publication. Failure may defer a future opportunity, but never launch an automatic paid retry of the same work.
replacements.new: `cognition-maintenance.ts` retains the last accepted reflection and a durable once-per-actor/game-day dispatch marker. Automatic idle eligibility also requires remembered experience and at least one game hour since the accepted reflection; queued requests still pass body, idle, provider and spending admission. The attempt marker is saved before dispatch, so failure does not authorize another automatic paid attempt that day. Real-time inspection/backoff and shared execution limits remain distinct. Current publication in `experience.ts` updates the accepted reflection time without advancing the retired processed-memory watermark. The test-only older proposal path is removal work under [CR11](maintainers/cognition-redesign.md#cr11--current-format-continuity-god-inspection-and-documentation), not the current scheduling contract. Daily dream consolidation remains the separately bounded completed-day review described above.
